name: 5-Amino-1MQ

lead: 5-Amino-1MQ is a small-molecule inhibitor of nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT), an enzyme that is more active in fat tissue in obesity. It is marketed online as an oral or injectable fat-metabolism supplement.
The evidence is confined to cell and mouse experiments, and no human trials have been published. Its use in looksmaxxing rests on extrapolation from these preclinical results.

paras: Inhibiting NNMT is thought to raise cellular NAD+ levels and the availability of methyl donors, which in mouse adipocytes shifted metabolism towards energy use and reduced fat cell size. In diet-induced obese mice, NNMT inhibitors reduced weight and fat mass, an effect that has not been confirmed in humans.

Human pharmacology, dosing and safety are unknown. The compound is unapproved, sold as a research chemical or supplement of uncertain purity, and its long-term effects on methylation and NAD metabolism have not been evaluated.
